written.title: "Go play GTA 6, we need to detox": Wardogs studio Bulkhead is taking a month-long break
written.description: What GamesRadar+ and Kotaku reported: ""Go play GTA 6, we need to detox": Wardogs studio Bulkhead is taking a month-long break", in their own words.
written.body:
This page collects what named outlets published about Grand Theft Auto VI, in their own words. This site wrote none of the sentences in quotation marks below. Each one links to the report it was taken from.

## GamesRadar+, 3 November 2026

["Go play GTA 6, we need to detox": Wardogs studio Bulkhead is taking a month-long break](https://www.gamesradar.com/games/fps/go-play-gta-6-we-need-to-detox-wardogs-studio-bulkhead-is-taking-a-month-long-break-and-it-wants-to-make-sure-players-know-they-can-f-off/)

The outlet's own summary:

> I don't need telling twice

> Every Friday GamesRadar+ Your weekly update on everything you could ever want to know about the games you already love, games we know you're going to love in the near future, and tales from the communities that surround them.

> With most games wondering how they'll hope to hold onto their audiences once Rockstar drops its nuke - and Fortnite offering near-unlimited freebies to certain lucky players - it's almost refreshing to see a team unapologetically accepting that its fans will have something else on their minds, and hoping that they'll come back once they're finished with Leonida.

## Kotaku, 3 November 2026

[Fan Who Went Viral Wishing To Stay Alive Long Enough To Play GTA 6 Has Passed Away - Kotaku](https://kotaku.com/fan-who-went-viral-wishing-to-stay-alive-long-enough-to-play-gta-6-has-passed-away-2000752775)

The outlet's own summary:

> The man's family confirmed he died on October 29 following complications from lung transplant surgery

> Earlier this year, Fort posted a video from his hospital bed titled “I just want to play GTA VI ” in which he detailed his situation and prognosis.

## Kotaku, 3 November 2026

[Wardogs Studio Boss Tells Players To 'F*ck Off' During December](https://kotaku.com/wardogs-bulkhead-december-gta-6-joe-brammer-steam-pc-multiplayer-2000752730)

The outlet's own summary:

> CEO Joe Brammer added, 'Go play GTA 6, we need to detox'

> A Wardogs soldier points a rocket launcher right at you. © Bulkhead The boss of Wardogs developer Bulkhead has told Edge magazine of his intentions to give the entire studio the whole month of December off from work, following the successful early-access launch of the tactical FPS.

Every report above is on the site's fixed source list. A report is not a confirmation: the mark on each linked entry says who said it.
